recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a smiling man in casual attire, positioned centrally against a scenic lakeside background during golden hour. The lighting is soft and warm, with a bright glow emanating from the right side, creating a high-key, optimistic atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head in the upper third
Horizontal text band cutting across the subject's waistline
Warm golden light on the right contrasting with blue sky on the left
Rocky shoreline in the foreground leading the eye toward the subject
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with lens flare effect
White v-neck t-shirt as a central bright anchor
Natural outdoor setting with water and hills

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupies roughly 60% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's white t-shirt acts as the primary visual anchor due to its high value and central position.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the torso to the horizontal text line, then follows the shoreline into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample sky and water space surrounding the subject to provide a sense of openness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm white and golden yellow (sunlight, shirt, skin tones).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and greens (sky, water, denim).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout, with moderate saturation in the sky and water to maintain a natural look.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy and sky tones

composition.relationshipToImage: continuation of the horizontal text band

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and color contrast within the same stylistic family (italicized sans-serif).
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the center-bottom third

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and flat terminals of the primary display text.
Provides a similar sturdy, classic sans-serif feel.
Suitable for the secondary subtitle text due to its narrower profile.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-quality photograph of a man with medium-length brown hair, smiling, wearing a white v-neck t-shirt and dark jeans. He is standing by a calm lake at sunset. The background features rolling green hills and a rocky shore. The lighting is bright and warm, coming from the right side, creating a slight lens flare.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two segments of text in a single horizontal line across the man's waist. The first segment should be in a heavy, black, italicized sans-serif font. The second segment should be in a medium-weight, muted blue, italicized sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-key and warm?
Is the text italicized and uppercase?
Does the text sit horizontally across the subject's midsection?

adjustableVariables: Time of day (golden hour vs. midday)
Subject's hair length and facial expression
Specific color of the secondary text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any unique jewelry or belt buckle details

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and landscape

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the man's smile looks natural and not distorted.
Check that the text does not obscure the face.
Verify the white shirt isn't 'blown out' (losing all detail).
Confirm the horizon line is level.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered casual portrait with a scenic outdoor background and a bold, horizontal, two-tone typographic overlay.
